envelope_request.name: TR1PhysicalTransitionV1
envelope_request.purpose: one common E1-E5 envelope for R4 and R6, with route-specific arithmetic payloads if necessary
envelope_request.deterministic_factor_rule: evaluate written whole-divisor terminal predicates in fixed order; after all miss, select the least prime factor of verified D_star
forbidden_inputs: cached family owner as an E3 proof
bare divisibility q divides D_star without an occurrence receipt
local checkpoint rank as parent-to-final E5

target_shapes.mark_behavior: root equation terminal; no recursive mark
target_shapes.admission_requirement: terminal verifier replays the explicit Type I or Type II certificate

target_shapes.existing_family_match: type_i_a_gt_one_overflow_residual by default; any refinement requires its own raw receipt

conditional_owner_refinements.type_i_low_support_persistent_overflow: only with an independently replayed same-chart promotion receipt
conditional_owner_refinements.type_i_a_one_overflow: only when raw target support_A equals 1 and its overflow receipt is verified
conditional_owner_refinements.type_i_high_support_sink: only with an independently replayed sink_scc_receipt
conditional_owner_refinements.type_i_full_carrier_post_g: forbidden unless provenance_kind=FULL_CARRIER_POST_G and full_carrier_scope are both established by an actual G handoff; a transverse proper-root label is insufficient

target_shapes.mark_behavior: preserve ROOT_SOL only if a universal identity lift is proved
target_shapes.T5_ticket_type: for R_T>p overflow, LOCAL_DROP only after an actual parent-to-final CHARGED rank comparison; otherwise reject or use a separately typed protocol theorem
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: none; common classifier determines the owner from exact raw provenance and dedicated receipts, never from this proposal list
target_shapes.admission_requirement: target passes the frozen common extractor, owner classifier, producer target declaration and queue gate

target_shapes.existing_family_match: an existing marked-absorb owner only if R_T
target_shapes.new_family_required: coordinator decision required if frozen grammar cannot represent the exact ABSORB protocol
target_shapes.mark_behavior: preserve ROOT_SOL only if a universal identity lift is proved
target_shapes.T5_ticket_type: TYPEI protocol drop CHARGED to ABSORB only after R_T
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: coordinator must expose the existing ABSORB owner in the frozen common grammar if not already representable
target_shapes.admission_requirement: target has R_T<p, a verified marked-absorb normal form, complete ABSORB protocol coordinates, an irreversible commit, and a common-admitted owner

target_shapes.mark_behavior: NONTRIVIAL_MARK bound to a strictly smaller equation rank and a universal Sol(n) to Sol(p) lift
target_shapes.owner_precedence_request: use existing generic-marked precedence only after mark receipt verification
target_shapes.admission_requirement: strictly smaller positive equation rank, content-addressed mark receipt, universal lift and common queue admission

activation_gates: symbolic exhaustive partition with no explicit residual
integer raw occurrence/E1 and priority proof
coordinator approval at target-shape and grammar gates
